description: TRUE self-upgrade: reconfigure on the Hub deployer-CT itself (no source isolation, no separate plain install). The Hub triggers the clone orchestrator on itself, the clone-CT runs the reconfigure against the Hub, and the Hub is replaced by a new CT that inherits its hostname/IP. Mirrors what a production operator triggers from the UI. Validation: post-replacement CT serves /api/version on the original Hub IP, the orchestrator clone CT is auto-destroyed by clone-cleanup-service, the debug bundle is adopted under the same restart-key on the new CT, and the new CT's Notes contain the original Hub URL in the proxvex:log-url marker (not the clone's URL).
